maddeler.e: بَلْسَمَ • (balsama) Iq (non-past يُبَلْسِمُ (yubalsimu), verbal noun بَلْسَمَة (balsama))
maddeler.t:
Etymology tree
Proto-Semitic *buśm-
Hebrew בָּשָׂםbor.
Ancient Greek βάλσαμον (bálsamon)bor.?
Arabic بَلْسَم (balsam)denom.
Arabic بلسم
Denominal verb from بَلْسَم (balsam). First attested in 1987.
